module: Flowgraph node "Display Flow" (simple type, category logic, tag util). Displays a green checked box when flow reaches the node (considered active if the last flow is less than 5 frames old). The tooltip shows an estimated refresh rate (1 / interval between two flows). Input pin: value (flow). No output.
notes: Game C.todo: "Randomly bugs out when first starting the execution sometimes".

work.desc: Stores the time elapsed since the last flow and the current frame number (mgr.frameCount).

drawMiddle.desc: Editor: draws the checked box (active/inactive) and accumulates time.
